reason: E1 reports that IrOsPtPdRhRu catalyzes a 12-electron ethanol oxidation process and notes that neighboring active sites with different local electronic structures in HEAs can tune selectivity, but it does not provide evidence that the performance arises specifically from a uniformly disordered structure or that partial segregation would degrade it. E2 only mentions general catalytic performance of HEA NPs and does not address ethanol oxidation or the effect of atomic mixing. Thus, the key premises linking uniform mixing to optimized adsorption and complete oxidation are unsupported by the cited
premises: Uniformly disordered atomic structure creates highly isolated active sites with synergistically tuned electronic properties
This structure enables optimized adsorption energies for ethanol and intermediates
Optimized adsorption promotes a complete 12-electron oxidation process
Partial phase segregation from annealing reduces atomic mixing and synergistic interactions
Reduced mixing leads to less optimal adsorption and a shift to incomplete oxidation
